Name: Florist Furniture for Alternative Textures
Author: farmerbeans
Description:
[size=5][b]Alternative Textures - Florist Furniture
[/b][/size][size=4]Decorate with Flowering furniture anywhere! Over 100 texture alternatives included. Matches the vanilla wood colors in the game. 
[/size]
[size=5][b]Just paint onto any of the following furniture items from the catalog:
[/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3]Bookcases (2 x 3)[/size]
[*][size=3]Short bookcases  (2 x 2, also covers the floor TV since this size item is rare in the furniture catalog)[/size]
[*][size=3]Tall decor (1 x 3, like the ceramic pillar)[/size]
[*][size=3]long tables (3 x 2, like the wine/spirits tables added in 1.6)[/size]
[*]End tables
[*][size=3]Tabletop plants[/size]
[*][size=3]Houseplants[/size]
[*]Narrow paintings (1 x 2)
[*]Square  paintings (2 x 2)
[/list]
[size=5][b]How to Use
[/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3]Install Alternative Textures Mod[/size]
[*][size=3]Purchase the paint bucket from Robin[/size]
[*][size=3]Use the paint bucket on any of the catalog furniture listed above[/size]
[/list]
